mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_recommendation ( SUGG_ID, SUGG_REASON, SUGGESTED_AT, NUTR_ID, FOOD_ID, INTERACTION, USR_ID ) VALUES ( AI_RECOMMENDATION_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{suggReason}, SYSDATE, #{nutrId}, #{foodId}, #{interaction}, #{usrId} )
mapper.select: SELECT SUGG_ID, SUGG_REASON, SUGGESTED_AT, NUTR_ID, FOOD_ID, INTERACTION, USR_ID FROM AI_RECOMMENDATION WHERE USR_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY SUGGESTED_AT ASC
SELECT SUGG_ID, SUGG_REASON, SUGGESTED_AT, NUTR_ID, FOOD_ID, INTERACTION, USR_ID FROM AI_RECOMMENDATION WHERE USR_ID = #{usrId} AND SUGG_ID = #{suggId}
